description: This Java class, ConceptSourceEditor, is a property editor used within the OpenMRS framework to serialize and deserialize ConceptSource objects for web and other data exchanges, supporting both ID and UUID lookups.

classes.name: ConceptSourceEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for serializing and deserializing ConceptSource objects, able to retrieve objects by ID or UUID.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptSource by its ID using the OpenMRS ConceptService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptSource by its UUID using the OpenMRS ConceptService.
